text:
maria: Quick heads-up — incoming external assessment next week. Need to finalize coverage matrix, KMS access window, RBAC temp roles, and retest slot options. Who can own coordination?
jon: I can own infra-side: KMS access + temporary keys. What's the desired access window?
maria: Ideally 2-hour window per day for 3 days, earliest start 09:00 PST. We need ephemeral creds + audit export after each window.
kevin: SRE: we need to enable debug-level audit logs for those windows. Can we tag requests with assessor ID so we can filter?
maria: Yes — assessor will use principal "vendor-assessor/ACME-2026" — agreed to tag in headers. Also require request-id prefix "acme-". Add to policy.
olga: Oncall: add me as primary pager for those windows. Also need runbook for evidence handoff. Can someone drop checklist?
maria: Dropping initial checklist:
- create ephemeral role: `assessor_read_only`
- KMS grant: decrypt only for s3-artifacts/acme/
- enable audit: retention 180d, stream to splunk/acme-index
- generate evidence bundle post-window
- schedule retest slots (see below)
jon: for KMS: i'll create a key alias `alias/assessor/acme-2026` and add key policy with external principal + condition `aws:RequestTag/acme-run = true`. Will draft.
kevin: For RBAC — propose terraform snippet:
```
resource "rbac_role" "assessor_read_only" {
  name = "assessor_read_only"
  permissions = ["s3:GetObject","logs:Read","kms:Decrypt"]
  temp_session = true
  session_ttl = "2h"
}
```
maria: perfect. Also need audit export command (one-liner):
`aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/audit --start-time <start> --filter-pattern "principal=vendor-assessor" > acme-audit-<ts>.json`
anna: question: will we allow create/delete operations for any resources? vendor said no.
maria: No create/delete. Read-only only. If they need to run exploit simulations, they can point at staging tests already set up.
olga: Retest slots preference: Wed 10:00-12:00 PST, Thu 14:00-16:00 PST. Can we offer backup Fri 09:00-11:00 PST?
jon: noted. I'll prepare IAM changes in a branch and tag @maria for review.
kevin: also adding automated regression alert: if any new high/critical vuln shows up in Snyk during windows, alert #incidents and pause tests.
maria: thanks. Can someone own the evidence archive upload to secure s3 (kms-encrypted) after each window? @jon?
jon: I'll do upload and share presigned link to assessors + sec. Will set object encryption with alias/assessor.
sec-bot: Reminder: create JIRA intake ticket SECURITY-6723 and mark "external assessment" + attach scope doc.
maria: Created ticket SECURITY-6723. I've attached scope and list of test targets. Please ack when infra changes are PR'd.
olga: ack. I'll put myself on call for all scheduled windows.
jon: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/834 — includes KMS policy + RBAC TF. @maria PTAL.
maria: Reviewing now. Small ask: add log sampling off for the windows (capture all). Also ensure time sync across test infra.
kevin: Confirmed NTP sync is enforced; sampling off in config.
maria: Great — final note: after the run we'll do a 30-minute triage with vendor + sec to decide remediation owners and retest targets. Meeting invite incoming.
